name: Repair kit
description: Use near a damaged raft tile to restore 50 health. Consumed only when a repair succeeds.

name: Bandage
description: Restores health gradually over ten seconds. Damage interrupts healing.

name: Workbench
description: Use this bench to craft building parts, survival equipment and specialized worktables.

name: Armory
description: Use this bench to craft weapons, defenses and their ammunition.

name: Engineering bench
description: Use this bench to craft navigation machines and power equipment.

name: Smelter
description: Fuel with wood and load scrap metal to produce metal plates.

name: Research table
description: Supply plates and wire, then use this table to craft electronics and rescue equipment.

name: Nails
description: Fasteners for reinforced construction.

name: Metal plate
description: Structural metal produced only by loading and fueling a smelter.

name: Gears
description: Mechanical transmission parts for towers and engines.

name: Wire
description: Crafting material for electrical equipment. Placed machines connect automatically.

name: Circuit board
description: Control electronics for rescue equipment.

name: Rain collector
description: Collects drinking water during periodic rain. Stores up to four drinks.

name: Crop bed
description: Plant a potato and water it with a fresh-water cup. Harvest three potatoes after a minute.

name: Water tank
description: Stores eight fresh-water cups. Fill from your cup, then drink or refill an empty cup.

name: Improved grill
description: Fuel with wood and load potatoes. Cooks three portions per batch.

name: Metal hook
description: A reinforced salvage hook with twice the durability of the wooden hook.

name: Salvage axe
description: Recover scrap from wreck debris at close range.

name: Bow
description: Aim and fire arrows at raiders. Requires arrows in your backpack.

name: Arrows
description: Ammunition for the bow.

name: Boarding shield
description: Hold the action button to block frontal raider attacks. Cannot attack while guarding.

name: Scrap armor
description: Use to wear armor that absorbs half of incoming raider damage until its protection runs out.

name: Wall
description: A solid defensive barrier. Raiders must break through it.

name: Gate
description: An openable barrier. Close it to block boarders.

name: Stairs
description: A walkable staircase to an elevated firing position.

name: Upper floor
description: A raised deck with supporting columns. Place adjacent stairs to reach it.

name: Railing
description: A low perimeter barrier that keeps crew on the deck.

name: Armored foundation
description: Reinforces a raft tile against hull attacks.

name: Tower platform
description: An elevated defensive emplacement. Equip a heavy tower and place it on this platform for reinforced health.

name: Ammo crate
description: Load ammunition from your backpack to resupply nearby towers.

name: Rope barricade
description: A cheap obstacle that delays boarding enemies.

name: Spike strip
description: Damages boarders crossing this tile. Wears down with each hit.

name: Net launcher
description: Consumes nets to slow nearby boarders. Little direct damage.

name: Ballista tower
description: Fires bolts at incoming raiders within its forward arc. Requires ammunition.

name: Harpoon tower
description: Automatically repels nearby sea beasts using harpoons.

name: Deck cannon
description: Slow, powerful cannon against pirate boats. Consumes cannonballs.

name: Nets
description: Ammunition for a net launcher.

name: Ballista bolts
description: Ammunition for a ballista.

name: Harpoons
description: Ammunition for a harpoon tower.

name: Cannonballs
description: Heavy ammunition for a deck cannon.

name: Alarm bell
description: Ring to announce and start a raid when you are ready. Successful raids yield salvage.

name: Lookout post
description: Inspect to identify the next raid before ringing the alarm bell.

name: Sail
description: Catch the wind to increase drifting salvage arrivals. Toggle the sail when placed.

name: Steering wheel
description: Choose a salvage heading: wood, metal or plastic.

name: Engine
description: Burns wood for powered salvage travel. Steering selects the resource route.

name: Generator
description: Burns wood and automatically powers devices within 7 meters. No cables needed.

name: Battery bank
description: Automatically connects within 7 meters. Stores power and keeps the radio running when fuel runs out.

name: Power relay
description: Automatically extends nearby power by 7 meters. Just place it; no cables needed.

name: Antenna mast
description: Required beside the rescue radio to broadcast a signal.

name: Rescue radio
description: Install a transmitter core and place near power and an antenna. Power connects automatically. Defend the broadcast to win.

name: Transmitter core
description: Guaranteed after the third raid. This expensive replacement prevents a lost core from ending the run.
